links.outcome: LLM information extraction from noisy, redundant patient chief complaints across 20 probes
links.effect: All four models showed functional defects; most collapsed under extreme noise. Qwen3-Max performed best and Gemini 2.5 worst. GPT-4o severely misjudged pulmonary embolism risk secondary to DVT.
links.quote: Under conditions of extreme noise, most models experienced a functional collapse.

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the robustness and failure modes (safety degradation under noisy clinical narrative input) of several LLMs using simulated clinical probes rated by clinicians, but it does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
